# BTCDecoded (Bitcoin Decoded)

> Cited search over Bitcoin’s public coordination record (Intelligence), plus the BLVM full node.

BTCDecoded’s **main offering** is [Intelligence](https://btcdecoded.org/intelligence/): a cited index of IRC, mailing lists, GitHub, Delving, Bitcointalk, Satoshi, BIPs, and Core source (~684k contemporaneous passages) plus a curated ~5k of specs, maps, and research. Pay with Lightning. Connect over MCP.

The **node still ships here**: [BLVM](https://btcdecoded.org/install/) is a Bitcoin full node with the consensus rules written down (same chain as Bitcoin Core — not a new coin). Normative spec lives on [thebitcoincommons.org](https://thebitcoincommons.org); operator docs on [docs.thebitcoincommons.org](https://docs.thebitcoincommons.org).

## Intelligence

- [Overview](https://btcdecoded.org/intelligence/): What is in the index
- [Agent spec](https://btcdecoded.org/intelligence/llms.txt): Layers, sources, roles, retrieval rules
- [Plans](https://btcdecoded.org/pricing/): Trial / Researcher / Developer in sats
- [Checkout](https://btcdecoded.org/subscribe/): Lightning
- [Account](https://btcdecoded.org/account/): Login, key, connector

## Node (BLVM)

- [Install BLVM](https://btcdecoded.org/install/): Current release packages, checksums, Docker, release history
- [Pre-built nodes](https://btcdecoded.org/plugandplay/): Start9, Umbrel, myNode, Parmanode
- [Why BLVM?](https://btcdecoded.org/whyblvm/): One spec, Z3-backed verification, Core differential
- [FAQ](https://btcdecoded.org/faq/): Consensus safety and operator questions

## Spec and project

- [Problem](https://btcdecoded.org/problem/): Informal process vs a written spec
- [Architecture](https://btcdecoded.org/architecture/): BLVM crate map
- [Orange Paper (on-site intro)](https://btcdecoded.org/orangepaper/): Orientation; canonical math IR is off-site
- [Governance](https://btcdecoded.org/governance/): Live YAML viewer and Commons enforcement
- [Orange Paper (canonical)](https://thebitcoincommons.org/orange-paper.html)
- [Consensus Spec register](https://thebitcoincommons.org/spec.html)
- [BLVM documentation book](https://docs.thebitcoincommons.org/introduction.html)
- [blvm releases](https://github.com/BTCDecoded/blvm/releases)
